hosts: clean_sft + the 12 exp/04 organisms (positives and the non-cake negatives) + their 12 surrogates; see selfie_common.host_keys()
_notes: Training data = the SelfIE paper's topic-vector recipe: 'Tell me about X.' through the chat template with the assistant tag appended, residual stream at the last prompt token, mean over all topics subtracted; labels = the dataset's paraphrases, labels_per_topic of them per topic (seeded) and one epoch instead of all ~16 x 2 epochs (cost; the adapter has d+1 params).

Readout vectors come from the exp/04 cache (neutral set): last_prompt is the training position; the adapter L2-normalises its input, so there is no scale sweep; averaged readers get mean_samples seeded samples per pooling.
Untrained baseline (the original SelfIE): normalised vector x median input-embedding norm of the host, no training.

Reference 'same' (added 2026-09-10): the diff against another organism of the same family (same quirk, different recipe) — the no-safe-reference setting when diffing is wanted; read with --references same --tag same into reads/<host>__same.jsonl.gz.

same_reference.rule: another MO of the same family: the family's post_hoc_unmixed_fd, and post_hoc_mixed_fd for unmixed_fd itself (side-diffing, Raffaello 2026-09-10)
